organization_name.description: Display name for the reserved local Organization (1-128 bytes after trimming).

project_name.description: Display name for the reserved default Project (1-128 bytes after trimming).

ActionRequest.description:
Shared request type for all service action dispatchers.

Every service handler deserializes `POST /v1/<service>` bodies into this
struct and forwards `action` + `params` to the corresponding dispatch
function, keeping HTTP and MCP input semantics aligned while each transport
owns its response envelope.

AgentErrorRecovery.description: Structured recovery guidance shared by every agent-facing error response.

action.description:
Recommended next action, such as `revise_and_retry`, `retry_later`,
`reauthenticate`, `rediscover`, or `do_not_retry`.

retry_after_ms.description: Optional retry delay supplied by the failing subsystem.

same_arguments.description:
Safety of repeating the exact same request: `safe`, `conditional`,
`discouraged`, or `never`.

AgentErrorResponse.description: Versioned error contract returned by every HTTP action failure.

contract_version.description: Contract version. Additive version-1 fields may be ignored by clients.

valid.description: Valid action names for this service.

capability_profile.description:
Sealed runtime capability profile. Integrated mode reports a distinct
value so Core can reject a standalone/all-features artifact at
readiness time.

pending.description:
Human-readable list of predicates not yet satisfied.
Present only on 503 responses.

provider_protocol.description: Private provider protocol accepted by the integrated profile.

status.description:
Status string: `"ok"` for liveness, `"ready"` or `"not_ready"` for
readiness.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since the server started accepting requests.
